deviations: Certifications emblems are bevelled (frustum lobes, blades and hub; four-sided pyramid diamonds; a square-frustum base bar) instead of flat-topped. With flat 4 mm tops the first capture showed no emblem at all: a flat brass face square to the camera mirrors the dark room. Same shapes, same brass, still 4 mm relief.

R2 judged 'emblems distinct in a 320 px grayscale thumbnail' on a 320 px crop of the case (EXPERIENCE §4 says 'a 320 px wide grayscale crop of the stop screenshot'). In the brief's full-frame thumbnail each medallion is about 10 px wide.

CFIA motion details the spec leaves open: each 6 s cycle rests 2.8 s (so t = 0 is the reduced pose), the falling ticket grows in over 0.3 s at y 0.52 instead of popping in, and the bottom ticket drops about 1 cm into the box during the 0.8 s sink, because a one-pitch sink alone (6 mm) leaves it 1 mm above the box top.
MUN X-bracing is on the left and right faces (x = +-0.45), so the front face stays open toward the camera.
Certifications swing: each medallion starts from rest at its own offset (0, 4, 8 s) and eases its amplitude in over 3 s, so t = 0 matches the reduced pose with no jump.
